'''Barbara Ruth Albert''' (born 9 December 1966) is a German chemist and rector of the [[University of Duisburg-Essen]]. She was Professor of Solid State Chemistry at the Eduard-Zintl-Institute for Inorganic and Physical Chemistry of the [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]]. From 2012 to 2013 she was the president of the [[German Chemical Society]].

Her research focuses on the synthesis of borides, borates and hydro borates, and solids with interesting physical properties.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chemie.tu-darmstadt.de/albert/ak_albert/mitarbeiterinnen/mitarbeiter_details_290.en.jsp|title=Einzelansicht|last=Albert|first=Arbeitsgruppe|website=Arbeitsgruppe Albert – Technische Universität Darmstadt|language=en|access-date=28 December 2018}}</ref>

== Life ==
Albert studied Chemistry at the [[University of Bonn]] from 1985 to 1990. She worked on her dissertation in the group of {{ill|Martin Jansen (chemist)|lt=Martin Jansen|de|Martin Jansen}} until 1995. With the help of the Feodor Lynen Fellowship of the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]], she worked as a postdoctoral fellow at the Materials Research Laboratory of the [[University of California, Santa Barbara]] in the group of [[Anthony Cheetham]]. In 2000 she habilitated at the University of Bonn, where she became a [[Privatdozent]] in 2001. In the same year she became a professor at the [[University of Hamburg]], where she was also Managing Director of the Institute for Inorganic and Applied Chemistry from 2003 to 2005. From 2005 to 2022 she was a professor at the [[Technische Universität Darmstadt]]. From 2012 to 2013 she was the president of the [[German Chemical Society]]. She has been a member of the supervisory board of [[Evonik Industries]] since 2014 and of the supervisory board of the [[Schunk Group]] since 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bbaw.de/MitgliederCV/Albert.pdf|title=CV Albert BBAW|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/fileadmin/downloads/Service_und_Informationen/Presse_OEffentlichkeitsarbeit/PDF/PM2011/GDCh-P_2011_45.pdf|title=Presseinformation|last=|first=|date=|website=www.gdch.de|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=13 December 2018}}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/service-information/nachricht/article/gesellschaft-deutscher-chemiker-erhaelt-neue-praesidentin-barbara-albert-ab-1-januar-fuer-zwei-jahre.html|title=Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker erhält neue Präsidentin – Barbara Albert ab 1. Januar für zwei Jahre im Amt|website=www.gdch.de|language=de|access-date=28 November 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://corporate.evonik.de/de/unternehmen/aufsichtsrat/|title=Aufsichtsrat – Management|website=corporate.evonik.de|access-date=28 November 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.schunk-group.com/de/unternehmen/aufsichtsrat|title=Aufsichtsrat {{!}}|website=www.schunk-group.com|language=de|access-date=28 November 2019}}</ref> Since April 2022, she is rector of the [[University of Duisburg-Essen]].<ref name="Willkommen an der ersten deutschen Universität des 21.
